Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeCreate
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Edge_t   Abc_EdgeCreate( int Id, int fCompl )                { return (Id << 1) | fCompl;             }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeCreate(Id int32, fCompl int32) Abc_Edge_t { return (Id << 1) | fCompl;             }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeId
Functions.Original: static inline int          Abc_EdgeId( Abc_Edge_t Edge )                       { return Edge >> 1;                      }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeId(Edge Abc_Edge_t) int32 { return Edge >> 1;                      }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeIsComplement
Functions.Original: static inline int          Abc_EdgeIsComplement( Abc_Edge_t Edge )             { return Edge & 1;                       }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeIsComplement(Edge Abc_Edge_t) int32 { return Edge & 1;                       }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeRegular
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Edge_t   Abc_EdgeRegular( Abc_Edge_t Edge )                  { return (Edge >> 1) << 1;               }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeRegular(Edge Abc_Edge_t) Abc_Edge_t { return (Edge >> 1) << 1;               }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeNot
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Edge_t   Abc_EdgeNot( Abc_Edge_t Edge )                      { return Edge ^ 1;                       }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeNot(Edge Abc_Edge_t) Abc_Edge_t { return Edge ^ 1;                       }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeNotCond
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Edge_t   Abc_EdgeNotCond( Abc_Edge_t Edge, int fCond )       { return Edge ^ fCond;                   }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeNotCond(Edge Abc_Edge_t, fCond int32) Abc_Edge_t { return Edge ^ fCond;                   }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeFromNode
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Edge_t   Abc_EdgeFromNode( Abc_Obj_t * pNode )               { return Abc_EdgeCreate( Abc_ObjRegular(pNode)->Id, Abc_ObjIsComplement(pNode) );       }
Functions.Draft: func Abc_EdgeFromNode(pNode *Abc_Obj_t) Abc_Edge_t { return Abc_EdgeCreate( Abc_ObjRegular(pNode).Id, Abc_ObjIsComplement(pNode) );       }

Functions.Name: Abc_EdgeToNode
Functions.Original: static inline Abc_Obj_t *  Abc_EdgeToNode( Abc_Ntk_t * p, Abc_Edge_t Edge )    { return Abc_ObjNotCond( Abc_NtkObj(p, Abc_EdgeId(Edge)), Abc_EdgeIsComplement(Edge) ); }
